claims.reason: The probe shows that the local tokenizer with add_special_tokens=False produces exactly the content tokens, the API returns one extra trailing <|endoftext|> vector, and the counts match (plain tokens = API vectors – 1). Offsets tile the text and the special token is trailing.
The prefix‑invariance and token‑identity tests demonstrate that vector i corresponds to token i; a different mapping would fail these checks.
Independent recomputation over all 66 children shows zero difference in both dense_1024 and dense_64, confirming the pooling logic.
The trailing special vector is never included in any token index list; dropping it is behaviour‑neutral. The strip merely enforces the count assertion.
Tests and evidence confirm mean(tok)[:64] == mean(tok[:64]) within float32 error, and dense_64 is the correctly normalised slice.
All guard tests (no‑token span fallback, token/dimension mismatch, orphan child) pass and raise the expected errors or warnings.
The median cosine of 0.9997 indicates a very small effect on this small‑parent fixture, which is consistent with the expectation that larger parents would show a larger effect.
The cost accounting matches the evidence: per‑token output is ~160× the pooled payload and ~55× the wall time, extrapolating to ~2911 s and ~13.6 GB for 968 pages.

logic_errors: In LateChunkEmbedder.embed_parent, the code calls a non‑existent method `self._embed_isolated(c)` when offsets are empty. The intended method is `self.embed_isolated(c)`.
suggestions: Rename the call to `self._embed_isolated(c)` to `self.embed_isolated(c)` to avoid an AttributeError.
Add a defensive check in `_content_tokens` to handle the unlikely case of an empty token matrix, returning a zero vector or raising a clear error.
Document the behaviour of dropping the trailing special vector in `_content_tokens` for clarity.
Consider logging a warning when `n_api == n_local` to alert users that the API did not return a trailing special token.
summary: All claims are supported by the evidence, but the module contains a logic error due to a misspelled method call.
